programmes.d: War hero Kip Marston asks Army Col. Gabe Wilson to look up his son, but he is totally unprepared for what Wilson finds.
A one-time outlaw tries to go straight with Matt Dillon's help but a beautiful woman leads him to a disastrous end.
An old friend of Kitty's travels West for the sole purpose of aiding her fugitive son's wife in childbirth.

Ron Moody, an Oscar nominee for his role in the movie Oliver, guest stars as a man torn between keeping his own self-respect and the friendship of a young boy and keeping his drunken promise to help two hired gunmen.
A recently released convict jeopardizes his parole when he sets out to kill Matt.
Doc comes upon a homesteader with a busted leg and a gun to protect himself from his wife.
A contemptible father pretends to have a change of heart when three nuns confront him about the care and custody of his two children.
Kitty Russell and a young gunsmith from the East are abducted from a stagecoach on the trail to Dodge City.
A pair of journalists from the east cause trouble.
The abduction of a teenage girl by Indians involves Matt Dillon in a long trek to rescue her and return her to her family.
Kitty gets shot trying to stop a fight in her saloon.
A reformed bounty hunter's lifelong dream for a ranch of his own leads him to accept one last job.
A buffalo hunter comes to Dodge not only to sell his hides, but also to pick a fight.
Matt Dillon comes to the aid of an innocent wolf hunter who discovers that a local rancher is butchering cattle illegally.
A feud ensues when the Dolans' cattle stray onto the Mossmans' land.
Matt traps a cattleman who shot two homesteaders.
Kitty Russell and a group of traveling companions are kidnapped and held for $62,000 ransom.
An elderly sheepherder who is against violence refuses to tell Matt the identity of the two cattleman who killed his sheep, burned his house, and left him for dead.
Matt frees a white woman and her daughter from slavery by the Indians.
Kitty Russell, injured and isolated by a stagecoach accident, must rely on a strange wild child to help her survive.
Matt Dillon and Festus become targets for revenge when they try to straighten out two trouble-making sons of an ex-lawman.
A storekeeper accuses a farmer of robbing him, but has no proof.
The brother of a man Matt was forced to kill vows to kill Matt by any means necessary.
A gunman tries to start a fight with a braggart.
An old girlfriend asks Matt to protect her from her husband.

A stranger in Dodge City employs a scare campaign to avenge the death of his preacher brother.
Chester's uncle thinks he is the marshal of Dodge City.
A love-sick roustabout faces a lynch mob when he accidentally kills a popular young cowhand.
A man who has had every motive to commit a murder swears that he is innocent.
Matt and Chester meet a man with two horses on the way back to Dodge who is not very friendly – until they see him spending money freely.
A man convicted in a gold mine swindle returns from prison to prove he is not a thief and coward.
A frustrated old maid determines to get herself a man, even at the cost of murder.
